notes: Uses DSACAgent architecture and training techniques from ensemble/train_rl_dsac_agent.py.
State/reward replay is Alpha3 exit-owner specific, not the original DSAC trading env.
Partial close, TWAP, market close, and hold-with-guard actions are included with reward masks and runtime gates; partial/TWAP labels are synthetic approximations from DP close/hold targets.
Feature sweep is based on alpha3_exit_owner_feature_analysis_20260515: market features are reduced by top-k or target-aware PLS.
promotion_gate: Must beat Alpha3 baseline and fixed exit4_pen0 on same eval horizon.
Must survive cost2/cost3 stress and later real L2 shadow route/fallback audit if orderbook data is reintroduced.
